author: bardic-inspiration
name: Fallen Armory
summary: Bursting corpses and a bone-spitting skeleton lurk under the rubble of the keep's armory.

environment.note: Rubble makes the room difficult terrain, and a loud noise drops more of the ceiling.

parts.text: Half the ceiling lies across the weapon racks. Something under the rubble is breathing, though nothing down there should be.

The {ref:creature/bloatrot-carrier}s and {ref:creature/zombie}s are buried under loose stone and rise when the party is halfway across. The {ref:creature/marrow-slinger} stays on top of the rubble pile and shoots. A loud noise brings more of the ceiling down.
